articles.author: InvestorsHub
articles.headline: POP Culture Group Reports Revenue Growth of 65%, Driven by Digital Entertainment Expansion (CPOP)
sourceWarnings: El comunicado original tiene un titular de 141 % que contradice el 65 % de su cuerpo y de esta noticia. Hora/zona del reporte sin confirmar: coincidencia por fecha, sin acreditar publicación anterior a la entrada.
articles.summary: InvestorsHub separately reported the issuer's half-year figures using 65% revenue growth. The issuer release's headline instead says 141%; the discrepancy remains explicit. Report timezone is unconfirmed, so this article matches by date without proving pre-entry availability.
articles.timestampEvidence: Finviz's dated June 10 news list identifies this separate InvestorsHub report at 10:30; original article and indexed Yahoo reproduction confirm identity and contents but not timezone.

articles.author: PR Newswire
articles.headline: POP Culture Group Reports Stellar Half-Year Results: Robust Business Growth with Revenue Surging 141% Year-Over-Year
sourceWarnings: Discrepancia interna: titular 141 % frente a 65 % y $68,9 M/$41,8 M en el cuerpo. Se verifica la publicación, no se valida el 141 % del titular.
articles.summary: The issuer's headline claims 141% revenue growth, but its body states 65%, with revenue of $68.9 million versus $41.8 million. This unresolved internal discrepancy is retained explicitly; the publication is verified, while the conflicting headline figure is not endorsed.
articles.timestampEvidence: Nasdaq syndication and Finviz date the issuer publication June 10, 2026 09:10; Nasdaq's publication clock is EDT. Original PR Newswire body independently exposes the inconsistent figures.
